title: Fabulous, refurbished property for sale in Cabopino Marina with stunning sea views.
summary: Step into luxury beachside living in this fabulous, refurbished property for sale in Cabopino Marina with stunning sea views.
description:
Step into luxury beachside living in this fabulous, refurbished property for sale in Cabopino Marina with stunning sea views.

As you enter the completely upgraded and remodelled contemporary apartment you will be captivated by the ultra-spacious open-plan modern design flooded with natural light, creating a vibrant and inviting atmosphere. Sleek and stylish, the open-plan concept integrates the kitchen seamlessly into the living area, promoting a fluid connection between cooking, dining, and socialising. High ceilings add to the feeling of space, accentuating the clean lines and modern finishes throughout.

The property features two generous bedrooms, with a walk-in wardrobe in the master bedroom, ensuring ample storage space and adding a touch of luxury to your everyday life. Two contemporary bathrooms and a guest toilet, perfectly catering to both comfort and convenience, complete the layout. Equipped with modern amenities including air conditioning, double glazing, electric blinds, and high-speed internet, this apartment is designed for contemporary living.

A private terrace overlooking the marina provides the perfect tranquil spot for your morning routine. For those who love the sound of waves and feeling soft sand beneath their feet, direct access to the beach awaits just steps away. Situated in a privileged beachside location, the community itself is a beautiful haven, featuring a communal swimming pool and a beachside pool area that invites relaxation and socialising with fellow residents.

With numerous restaurants and beach bars within walking distance in Cabopino Marina, you can indulge in a variety of culinary delights without having to travel far. The proximity to Marbella’s upscale shopping, dining, entertainment, transport links and all the key areas along the coast, adds to the convenience, making this apartment a perfect blend of comfort and accessibility. In addition, with a 2-car garage, parking is never a concern in this coastal paradise.

Whether you are drawn to the tranquillity of the beach, the vibrant community atmosphere, or the sleek modern design, this contemporary apartment in Cabopino offers a lifestyle that is both luxurious and convenient. Don’t miss the opportunity to make this stunning property your own.
